remarks: Welcome to 7161 Lullaby Lane, a charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home offering 1,205 square feet of living space on a spacious 6,600-square-foot corner lot. A beautifully manicured front lawn, mature landscaping, and a lovely fruit-bearing avocado tree that adds shade and character create wonderful curb appeal. Inviting cement walkways lead to a spacious covered front porch, welcoming you home. Step inside to a generous family room featuring new hardwood flooring and recessed lighting, opening naturally to the dining room, where a ceiling fan and sliding glass doors overlooking the backyard create a comfortable space filled with natural light.
